description: Issue #199, the guardrail: a notice must never mask a blocking warning. Same declaration as case 53 — an issue whose product IS the harness, `.commandmate/verify.yaml` named under `## 対象ファイル` (this is the shape #199 measured in Kewton/BorderFreeKidsMap, where adding a verify gate means editing verify.yaml, ci.yml and the parity checker together) — but this body states no acceptance criteria. So the plan carries both severities at once, and the status must be decided by the BLOCKING one: `partial`, with the notice still present and still annotated. A runner that computed the status from the LAST warning, or from any single entry rather than from 'is there at least one blocking', would return success here and lose the fact that nobody wrote down what done means. The harness path itself derives no test companion (§5.1 leaves .yaml alone), so the four companions below all come from the ONE non-harness source path: the notice changes what the run is coloured, never what the worker may touch.

warning_details_include: #418: Acceptance criteria are unclear; add 1-3 concrete completion checks.
